technical_regime_context.source_rule: equal-weight arithmetic mean of other four completed closes; common complete 54-bar days; strict prior date; no fill

known_limitations: All periods are historically exposed development data, not independent OOS.
ML V1 model is draft/unfrozen; no model selection is performed.
Slippage is 0.0 and is not simulated.
Risk sizing is based on signal close; next-open gaps can change realized stop risk.
Predictions are fixed-model historical development forecasts and are not OOF or live signals.

risk_contract.gap_risk_note: Next-open gaps may exceed estimated signal-price stop risk.

details.sharpe_annualization: daily mark-to-market returns, population std, sqrt(252)
